spans.s:
káṇa, m. a small grain (as of dust or rice).
[cf. kaniṣṭha.]

kāṇá, a. one-eyed; perforated (of the
eye), blind.

kaṇṭaki-kṣīrin, m. pl. thorn-plants and
milk-plants.

kaṇṭakin, a. thorny; as m. thorn-plant.
[kaṇṭaka.]

kāṇa-bhūti, m. Kānabhūti, name of a
Yaksha, see 53^3N. [lit. ‘Blind-luck.’]

kā́ṇḍa, m. n. section; joint of a stalk
from one knot to another; arrow.
